summary.text: This opportunity briefing explores combining global local attention, transformer, and decoder architectures to improve audio-visual speech separation. By integrating global-local attention blocks into a lightweight encoder-decoder separator, the system aims to capture multi-scale dependencies while reducing computational costs. According to DVF scoring, this combination receives a feasibility axis score of 2.0, a desirability score of 4.0, and a viability score of 5.0.

target_user.text: The target users are developers and practitioners building voice agents, interfaces, and speech processing systems that require efficient audio-visual speech separation as a preprocessing step.

jtbd.text: Extract target speech from noisy acoustic environments efficiently without incurring the high parameter counts and computational costs typical of traditional audio-visual speech separation methods.

value_prop.text: Achieves high-performance audio-visual speech separation with significantly reduced parameter counts, lower MACs, and faster GPU inference speed compared to existing models.

riskiest_assumption.text: The riskiest assumption is that integrating global-local attention blocks into a lightweight decoder architecture will maintain separation quality while drastically lowering computational overhead, constrained by a feasibility score of 2.0.

mvp.text: Build a technical proof of concept using existing packages to test whether a lightweight encoder-decoder separator with global-local attention blocks can process audio-visual inputs at a proposed threshold of at least 6x faster inference speed.
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Achieving a proposed threshold of more than 50 percent fewer parameters and a proposed threshold of greater than 2.4x reduction in MACs compared to baseline audio-visual speech separation models.

kill_criteria.text: If the prototype fails to achieve a proposed threshold of 6x faster GPU inference speed or experiences severe degradation in speech separation quality, the approach is killed.

open_source.use: Provides foundational transformer model definitions and attention mechanism building blocks for the encoder-decoder architecture.
Supplies low latency speech-to-text components and interface tooling for evaluating downstream speech workflows.

to_build.text: Develop the custom global-local attention block layer tailored for lightweight encoder-decoder separation.
